allot.subject: Monitoring Agency Report
allot.text: In terms of Regulation 32 of the SEBI Listing Regulations, please find attached report of Monitoring Agency (Acuite Ratings and Research Limited) confirming no deviation in the utilization of proceeds of funds raised by Indiabulls Limited (formerly Yaari Digital Integrated Services Limited) (the  Company ), through preferential issue of convertible warrants, during the quarter ended September 30, 2026.The above-mentioned Report, for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, which is self-explanatory and was placed before the Audit Committee of the Company, at its meeting held today i.e. November 5
